name: versus-v16-eight-slots
description: Assign and release unique slots 0..7 and choose an unoccupied map start for each join or respawn.

replacements.new:
// a 1v1 versus mode is implicitly non-coop, so nothing is lost by omitting it.
    MaxPlayers=2
    ScoreLimit=3
    RespawnDelay=3.00
    CountdownDuration=3.00
    MatchOverDuration=5.00
    DefaultPlayerClass=Class'HGame.HPVersusHarry'
    GameReplicationInfoClass=Class'HGame.HPVersusGRI'
    // HPVersusHarry owns HPVersusPRI from spawn, preserving PlayerName/PlayerID.
    bDeathMatch=True
}
